content.title: About
content.content: Nonfat Greek yogurt is a thick, creamy dairy product made by straining regular yogurt to remove whey. It is high in protein, virtually fat‑free, and has a neutral flavor, making it a versatile base for meals and snacks.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Greek yogurt originates from the Mediterranean region, where it is known as “straggisto.”
Straining boosts protein content to about 10 g per 100 g of product.
The nonfat version retains all the nutrients of milk without the caloric fat.
Greek yogurt is often used in cooking as a substitute for sour cream or mayonnaise.
It gained major popularity in the United States in the 1990s as a diet-friendly food.

items.title: High protein content
items.content: Nonfat Greek yogurt provides roughly 10 g of protein per 100 g, supporting muscle growth and repair.

items.title: Low fat
items.content: The absence of fat makes it suitable for low‑calorie and low‑fat dietary plans.

items.title: Rich in probiotics
items.content: Live cultures such as Lactobacillus and Bifidobacterium promote gut health.

items.title: Source of calcium
items.content: Calcium contributes to strong bones and teeth and supports muscle function.

items.title: Low sugar
items.content: Naturally contains very little sugar, beneficial for blood‑glucose management.

items.title: Lactose intolerance
items.content: People with lactose intolerance may experience discomfort after consuming yogurt.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Allergy to casein or whey protein requires complete avoidance.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Some brands add salt; those with hypertension should check the label.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy it plain, blend into smoothies, use in sauces, dips, dressings, or incorporate into baked goods as a substitute for butter or sour cream.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep refrigerated at 2‑4 °C in the original container. Once opened, consume within 5‑7 days. Do not freeze, as texture may change.
